title.zh: 一个展开在语境中的读法

statement.zh: 语境中的诸读法（量子的亦然）总是一个世界；不依语境的描述恰在它们粘合处存在；所立与交换恰在流平衡处同样读出变化；算入其余时每个世界都是交换的一次运行；在不变之下意义不停在边界上。
statement.en: Readings in context, quantum ones too, always make one world; a context-free description exists exactly where they glue; standing and exchange read change alike exactly where the flow balances; counting the rest, every world is one run of exchange; under invariance significance stops at no boundary.

laws.zh: 沿一个运行，语境系统的诸识，每个主张连同其语境，是一个世界的关系项，恰在以其值被识处活跃；如 Frame.world，其中没有什么立着或被交换；不用粘合，所以量子的识亦然。
laws.en: Along a run, the registrations of a contextual system, each claim read with its context, are the relata of one world, each active exactly where it is registered with its value; as in Frame.world, nothing stands or is exchanged in it; no gluing is used, so quantum registrations are included.

laws.zh: 一个条件跨一步的变化由所立读作水平的升与降，由交换读作流给它超出所取的与取它超出所给的；两者读得一样恰当流在那一步平衡，所以两种读法处处粘合恰当流平衡，不依语境的变化主张的框架恰在此时相合。
laws.en: A condition's change across a step is read by its standing, as the rise and fall of its level, and by the exchange, as what the flow gave it beyond what it took and took beyond what it gave; the two read it alike exactly where the flow balances there, so the readings glue at every step exactly where the flow balances, and a frame of context-free claims of change fits exactly then.

laws.zh: 算入其余，两种读法处处粘合：其余的交换就是两种读法之差，算作关系项；每个世界的两种读法处处粘合，世界自己的读法恰在它平衡处处处粘合，那恰是其余从不活跃之处，世界是交换之律的一次运行，其所立是世界的。
laws.en: With the rest counted the two readings glue at every step: the rest's exchange is the difference between them, counted as a relatum; the readings of every world glue at every step, its own readings glue exactly where it balances, which is exactly where the rest is never active, and the world is a run of the law of exchange whose standings are the world's.

laws.zh: 意义以同样的不变标准（重述，不是新结果）：整体可容许、预设对边界不变时，预设在边界划于某处时成立恰当从那个立场一切的延续都有意义；以含有自身闭包的区域为界的对手恰在区域是一切时满足这一标准。
laws.en: Significance under the same standard of invariance (a restatement, not a new result): with the whole admissible and the presupposition boundary-invariant, it holds as the boundary is drawn somewhere exactly where the continuation of everything has significance from that standpoint; a rival bounded by a region holding the self's closure meets the standard exactly where the region is everything.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。意义只作为定理所量化的谓词出现；不变是条件（BoundaryInvariant），整体可容许。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. Significance enters only as a predicate the theorems quantify over; invariance is a condition (BoundaryInvariant), with the whole admissible.

does_not_show.zh: 诸读法粘合：量子的识不粘合（Square.no_context_free_values）。
does_not_show.en: That the readings of an unfolding glue: quantum registrations do not (Square.no_context_free_values).

does_not_show.zh: Contextual.world 的关系项是被索引的主张，活跃即被识，其中没有什么立着或被交换：它不说明诸读法组成一个有流与依存网的世界。
does_not_show.en: The relata of Contextual.world are indexed claims, active where registered, and nothing stands or is exchanged in it: it does not show that the readings form a world with a flow and a web.

does_not_show.zh: 意义满足不变的标准、预设成立：意义的两条重述 Becoming.Boundaries，不加结果。
does_not_show.en: That significance meets the standard of invariance, and that the presupposition holds: the two significance theorems restate Becoming.Boundaries and add no result.

detail.zh: Mermin–Peres 方阵：诸识无处粘合（Square.no_whole），量子比特实现它（Becoming.Quantum）；按 Contextual.world 它们仍是一个世界的关系项。
detail.en: The Mermin–Peres square: its registrations glue nowhere (Square.no_whole), and qubits realize it (Becoming.Quantum); by Contextual.world they are still the relata of one world.

next_delta.zh: 主张之间的关系作为 Contextual.world 的流与依存；连续时间与实数的量；独立审查。
next_delta.en: Relations among claims as the flow and web of Contextual.world; continuous time and real amounts; an independent review.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-14：“why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”，“no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”，“for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”；对从关系开始的三步重建：“please, finish all”。本结果是第三步：一个统一的定理形式，语境中的读法为一般情形，World 为读法粘合的情形；意义以同样的不变标准读作两分。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：核心在许多类型上陈述的是一个展开的读法；原来世界的一个前提，现在是一个部分的状态：其余是否闲置；第二部分的公理在规律所满足的不变之下归于预设，即 Ren 2026-10-10 所说的“belief”，没有它自身“can not justify itself”。
correspondence.en: Ren, 14 October 2026: “why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”, “no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”, “for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”; and, to the relation-first re-founding in three steps, “please, finish all”. This result is the third step: one theorem shape for unity, readings in context the general case and World the case where readings glue; significance read as a dichotomy under the same standard of invariance. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): what the core states on many types are readings of one unfolding; what was a premise of the world is now a state of a part, whether the rest is idle; and under the invariance the laws meet, the axiom of Part II comes to the presupposition, the “belief” without which, Ren wrote on 10 October 2026, the self “can not justify itself”.

detail.en: Advances its next step: whatever reads an unfolding is a reading in context, the readings are always one world, and World is the case where they glue; it does not show that every becoming is an unfolding in discrete steps.

detail.zh: 诸读法何时粘合为一，对奇偶约束：恰在没有一组语境矛盾处。
detail.en: When readings glue into one, for parity constraints: exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts.
